newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Two S.Korean firms pass on 22,500T wheat tender.
newsitem.headline: Two S.Korean firms pass on 22,500T wheat tender.

text.p: South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp and Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd jointly passed on tenders to buy 22,500 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat due to higher-than-expected prices, company officials said on Wednesday.
Cheiljedang sought 9,000 tonnes at basis prices over December futures on the U.S. grain futures exchanges including the Chicago Board of Trade, company officials said.
Dongah Flour planned to buy the remaining 13,500 tonnes at fixed prices.

Traders said Japanese trading house Kanematsu Corp made the lowest offer at between $145.30 and $184.55 a tonne for fixed prices, and between 32.25 cents to 108.05 cents per bushel for basis prices over December futures. Both offers were on a cost and freight basis.
Shipment was set for September 10-October 10 to the southeastern port of Pusan.
